product_overview: Student Flow PM is a specialized project management platform optimized for students, combining AI-powered assistance with an intuitive interface tailored to academic workflows. It balances complexity and usability by addressing student-specific challenges such as project inertia, progress visibility, and administrative burden through intelligent automation and data-driven insights.
core_goals: Eliminate friction with AI-assisted project kickoff and task generation minimizing startup inertia
Provide context-aware project management understanding academic workflows and deadlines
Deliver data-driven insights and automated analytics for visual progress tracking
Design an intuitive, student-centric user experience optimized for academic projects
key_features: User Authentication and Profile Management via Better Auth with email signup, password recovery, and notification preferences
Multi-step Project Creation Wizard with AI-generated task breakdowns and timeline suggestions
Comprehensive Task Management including CRUD operations, nested subtasks, status tracking, and dependencies
AI-powered features such as smart task generation, document analysis, progress insights, and timeline recommendations
Calendar & Timeline views for visual deadline and milestone management with color-coded priorities
Resource Management supporting file and link uploads with tagging and version tracking
Real-time Collaboration via project messaging channels and granular notification settings
Data Insights Dashboard showing progress charts, velocity tracking, and productivity patterns
Collaborative Project Workspace for shared resources, team task overview, and messaging integration
user_flow_summary: Primary Flow: From dashboard, create a project via multi-step wizard; AI suggests tasks/milestones; confirm; access project page with task board and AI sidebar
Secondary Flow: Upload academic documents for AI document analysis that extracts key requirements and auto-generates tasks for review and acceptance
Tertiary Flow: Use calendar view to navigate tasks by due date, quick add new tasks, reschedule, and edit task details
validation_criteria: Successful user registration, login, and profile management with secure authentication and profile updates
Project creation flow completes with AI-generated suggestions and projects appear correctly in dashboard
Tasks can be created, edited, deleted, and reordered with accurate status and priority updates
AI services process documents and yield relevant task suggestions and timeline recommendations
Calendar displays tasks accurately and supports user interactions like quick add and rescheduling
File and link uploads are functional and resources can be linked to tasks and projects
Real-time messaging enables project team communication with notifications and thread support
Dashboard analytics accurately reflect project progress, velocity, and individual productivity trends
System maintains performance benchmarks: page load under 2 seconds, API response under 500ms, and 99.5% uptime
